28.description: These tokens represent common prefixes and initial syllables in the Hindi language.

92.description: This feature vector activates on subwords and fragments of Hindi script alongside English text and numbers.

149.description: This feature vector represents subword tokens and fragments of common Hindi words.

177.description: This vector represents Hindi vowel signs combined with commas or punctuation marks.

169.description: This vector activates on Hindi subordinating conjunctions, conditional markers, and relative adverbs denoting time and condition.

127.description: These tokens represent common Hindi vowel signs, nasalization markers, and grammatical suffixes used in Devanagari script.

41.description: These tokens are common Hindi verb roots, suffixes, and inflections used to form base action words in the language.

56.description: This feature vector activates strongly on sub-word tokens, prefixes, and character n-grams commonly found in Hindi and other Devanagari-script languages.
